text:
maria xu: Hey team — my Redwood corpcard was blocked by the bank while I was in Tokyo. Had to pay for the hotel and an overnight taxi on my personal card (~¥43,200 / ~$320). Can finance expedite reimbursement? I filed a dispute but it looks like unblocking might take 48+ hrs.
sam (travel-ops): ugh. Sorry Maria. Bank flagged foreign transaction pattern. Did you try the one-time unblock code? Card portal > Support > Reactivate. If still blocked, we can switch you to a virtual card for the trip.
maria xu: tried the portal, got an "action required" screen and it asks for ID verify. Don't have time. I attached photos of itemized hotel folio and taxi receipt.
luis (manager): Confirming this was client travel and overnight stay for meetings on 3/9. Approve reimbursement for the personal-card charges. Please fast-track. :white_check_mark:
card-bot: ALERT: Corporate card 4433 flagged in JP. Transaction block reason: "suspicious-geo". Suggested actions: contact issuing bank + open internal ticket FIN-807.
ola (finance): Thanks for the receipts, Maria. Two options: (A) Priority reimbursement via Payout (bank transfer) if manager approval + itemized receipts (3 business days), or (B) Temporary ATM top-up advance (same-day up to $500) — requires HR approval for payroll offset. Which do you want? Also we need evidence you attempted to resolve with card issuer.
maria xu: priority reimbursement please. I already messaged bank support and have reference #JP-9981. Uploaded the bank chat screenshot to Expensify under "card-block-jp".
ola (finance): Got it. Upload looks good. Marking as PRIORITY and creating FIN-807. Please note payout will be in USD equivalent; expect small FX rounding.
luís (manager): (typo fix) luis: noted. also pls confirm per-diem not exceeded — hotel rate is within policy.
maria xu: confirmed per-diem ok. hotel was 18,900 JPY/night.
ola (finance): Approved for priority payout. Action items for Maria: 1) Confirm last 4 of corpcard (for internal ref), 2) paste bank chat ref. After that we push payment.
maria xu: last 4 = 4433; bank ref = JP-9981.
ola (finance): Payment queued under FIN-807-P. Expected settlement 3 business days. If settlement fails or FX issues, we'll fallback to ATM top-up advance and notify. :slightly_smiling_face:
maria xu: thank you so much. Really appreciate the quick help — saved me from an extra cash run. :relieved:
